import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule 1: No Right-Leaning Red (Matches Dafny)
    (if is_red r then False else True) ∧
    -- Rule 2: No Double Red on Left (Matches Dafny)
    -- Check: If Left is Red, then Left.Left must NOT be Red.
    -- This applies regardless of 'c' (current color).
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => 
       (match ll with | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => False | _ => True)
     | _ => True)

-- This definition is tricky because LLRBT insert allows the root to be red temporarily or permanently if it's the root of the whole tree (though usually root is black).
-- However, the recursive step needs a weaker invariant.
-- Dafny spec says: "This allows the root to be Red or Black"
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  -- We need to check red properties. Dafny's satisfies_red_props handles recursive checks.
  -- But wait, Dafny's `satisfies_red_props` seems to strictly forbid right-leaning reds everywhere?
  -- Let's re-read Dafny carefully.
  -- satisfy_red_props:
  --   left_ok && right_ok && right_is_black && no_double_red
  --   Right is black: if right is red -> false.
  --   No double red on left: if left is red, left.left cannot be red? No, `l.is_red` then `l.left` check?
  --   Dafny: `match this.left { case Some(l) => if l.is_red then match l.left { case Some(ll) => !ll.is_red ...`
  --   This means: If I am any node, my right child cannot be red. And if my left child is red, IT'S left child cannot be red (no consecutive reds on left edge).
  --   What about Me being Red and Left being Red? Dafny spec doesn't explicitly ban `this.is_red && this.left.is_red` in `satisfies_red_props` itself?
  --   Ah, `no_double_red` checks `this.left` (l) and `l.left` (ll).
  --   So it prevents `Red -> Red` on the left edge.
  satisfies_red_props t



-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Left child of a node (`Empty` for the empty tree). -/
def leftN : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

/-- Paint the root of a tree black. -/
def paintBlack : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ x l r => Node.Tree Color.Black x l r

def flipC : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

/-- The contribution of a node's colour to its black height. -/
def bhOff : Color → Int
  | Color.Red => 0
  | Color.Black => 1

/-- The "no red-red at the root" side condition. -/
def OK (t : Node) : Prop := is_red t = true → is_red (leftN t) = false

/-- LLRBT fix-up after inserting into the *left* subtree: the only repair that
can be needed is a double red on the left spine, which is fixed by a right
rotation immediately followed by a colour flip. -/
def balL (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) : Node :=
  match l with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red xl (Node.Tree Color.Red xll lll rll) lr =>
      Node.Tree (flipC c) xl (Node.Tree Color.Black xll lll rll)
        (Node.Tree Color.Black x lr r)
  | _ => Node.Tree c x l r

/-- LLRBT fix-up after inserting into the *right* subtree: a right-leaning red
is rotated left, unless the left child is red too, in which case the colours are
flipped. -/
def balR (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) : Node :=
  match r with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red xr lr rr =>
      match l with
      | Node.Tree Color.Red xl ll rl =>
          Node.Tree (flipC c) x (Node.Tree Color.Black xl ll rl)
            (Node.Tree Color.Black xr lr rr)
      | _ => Node.Tree c xr (Node.Tree Color.Red x l lr) rr
  | _ => Node.Tree c x l r

/-- Recursive LLRBT insertion (Sedgewick). -/
def ins (t : Node) (v : Int) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c x l r =>
      if v < x then balL c x (ins l v) r
      else if x < v then balR c x l (ins r v)
      else Node.Tree c x l r

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  paintBlack (ins (paintBlack t) v)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

/-! ### Basic rewriting lemmas -/

@[simp] theorem view_empty' : view Node.Empty = (∅ : Set Int) := rfl

@[simp] theorem view_tree' (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} := rfl

@[simp] theorem isred_red' (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    is_red (Node.Tree Color.Red x l r) = true := rfl

@[simp] theorem isred_black' (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    is_red (Node.Tree Color.Black x l r) = false := rfl

@[simp] theorem isred_empty' : is_red Node.Empty = false := rfl

@[simp] theorem leftN_tree' (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    leftN (Node.Tree c x l r) = l := rfl

@[simp] theorem leftN_empty' : leftN Node.Empty = Node.Empty := rfl

@[simp] theorem bst_empty' : is_bst Node.Empty ↔ True := Iff.rfl

@[simp] theorem bst_tree' (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    is_bst (Node.Tree c x l r) ↔
      ((∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ y ∈ view r, y > x) ∧ is_bst r) :=
  Iff.rfl

@[simp] theorem props_empty' : satisfies_red_props Node.Empty ↔ True := Iff.rfl

-- `satisfies_red_props` for a node, restated with `is_red`/`leftN`.
set_option linter.unreachableTactic false in
set_option linter.unusedTactic false in
theorem props_tree (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    satisfies_red_props (Node.Tree c x l r) ↔
      satisfies_red_props l ∧ satisfies_red_props r ∧ is_red r = false ∧
        (is_red l = true → is_red (leftN l) = false) := by
  rcases r with _ | ⟨cr, xr, lr2, rr2⟩ <;>
    rcases l with _ | ⟨cl, xl, ll, lr⟩ <;>
      [skip; (rcases cl with _ | _ <;> [(rcases ll with _ | ⟨cll, xll, lll, rll⟩ <;>
          [skip; rcases cll with _ | _]); skip]);
       skip; (rcases cl with _ | _ <;> [(rcases ll with _ | ⟨cll, xll, lll, rll⟩ <;>
          [skip; rcases cll with _ | _]); skip])] <;>
    first
      | (rcases cr with _ | _ <;>
          simp [satisfies_red_props, is_red, leftN] <;> tauto)
      | (simp [satisfies_red_props, is_red, leftN] <;> tauto)

/-! ### Black height -/

/-- Black height of a well-formed node: the left subtree's height plus the
colour offset (`0` for red, `1` for black). -/
theorem bh_tree_eq (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h1 : black_height l ≠ -1) (h2 : black_height r = black_height l) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) = black_height l + bhOff c := by
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_pos (⟨h1, by rw [h2]; exact h1, h2.symm⟩ :
    black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r)]
  cases c <;> simp [bhOff] <;> rfl

theorem bh_inv (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ -1) :
    black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r = black_height l := by
  by_cases hh : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height l = black_height r
  · exact ⟨hh.1, hh.2.2.symm⟩
  · exact absurd (by simp only [black_height]; rw [if_neg hh]) h

theorem bh_pos (t : Node) : black_height t = -1 ∨ 1 ≤ black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => right; exact le_refl 1
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      by_cases hh : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height l = black_height r
      · right
        rw [bh_tree_eq c x l r hh.1 hh.2.2.symm]
        rcases ihl with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd h1 hh.1
        · cases c <;> simp only [bhOff] <;> omega
      · left; simp only [black_height]; rw [if_neg hh]

theorem bh_ge (t : Node) (h : black_height t ≠ -1) : 1 ≤ black_height t := by
  rcases bh_pos t with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 h
  · exact h1

/-! ### Painting the root black -/

@[simp] theorem view_paintBlack (t : Node) : view (paintBlack t) = view t := by
  cases t <;> simp [paintBlack]

@[simp] theorem bst_paintBlack (t : Node) : is_bst (paintBlack t) ↔ is_bst t := by
  cases t <;> simp [paintBlack]

@[simp] theorem props_paintBlack (t : Node) :
    satisfies_red_props (paintBlack t) ↔ satisfies_red_props t := by
  cases t <;> simp [paintBlack, props_tree]

@[simp] theorem isred_paintBlack (t : Node) : is_red (paintBlack t) = false := by
  cases t <;> simp [paintBlack]

theorem bh_paintBlack (t : Node) (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    black_height (paintBlack t) ≠ -1 := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simpa [paintBlack] using h
  | Tree c x l r =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := bh_inv c x l r h
      have hge := bh_ge l h1
      simp only [paintBlack]
      rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Black x l r h1 h2]
      show black_height l + 1 ≠ -1
      omega

theorem ok_paintBlack (t : Node) : OK (paintBlack t) := by
  intro h; simp at h

/-! ### Shape lemmas for the balancing combinators

These are all definitional (`rfl`); stating them explicitly keeps the big
proofs below from having to reduce the nested `match`es. -/

theorem balL_eq_node (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : ¬ (is_red l = true ∧ is_red (leftN l) = true)) :
    balL c x l r = Node.Tree c x l r := by
  cases l with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree cl xl ll lr =>
      cases cl with
      | Black => rfl
      | Red =>
          cases ll with
          | Empty => rfl
          | Tree cll xll lll rll =>
              cases cll with
              | Red => exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ h
              | Black => rfl

theorem balL_rot (x xl xll : Int) (lll rll lr r : Node) :
    balL Color.Black x
        (Node.Tree Color.Red xl (Node.Tree Color.Red xll lll rll) lr) r
      = Node.Tree Color.Red xl (Node.Tree Color.Black xll lll rll)
          (Node.Tree Color.Black x lr r) := rfl

theorem balR_eq_node (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) (h : is_red r = false) :
    balR c x l r = Node.Tree c x l r := by
  cases r with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree cr xr lr rr =>
      cases cr with
      | Red => exact absurd h (by simp)
      | Black => rfl

theorem balR_rot (c : Color) (x xr : Int) (l lr rr : Node)
    (h : is_red l = false) :
    balR c x l (Node.Tree Color.Red xr lr rr)
      = Node.Tree c xr (Node.Tree Color.Red x l lr) rr := by
  cases l with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree cl xl ll rl =>
      cases cl with
      | Red => exact absurd h (by simp)
      | Black => rfl

theorem balR_flip (x xl xr : Int) (ll rl lr rr : Node) :
    balR Color.Black x (Node.Tree Color.Red xl ll rl)
        (Node.Tree Color.Red xr lr rr)
      = Node.Tree Color.Red x (Node.Tree Color.Black xl ll rl)
          (Node.Tree Color.Black xr lr rr) := rfl

/-! ### The bundled node / balancing specifications -/

/-- The bundled specification for a node that needs no rebalancing. -/
theorem node_spec (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hbl : is_bst l) (hbr : is_bst r)
    (hlx : ∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) (hxr : ∀ y ∈ view r, y > x)
    (hhl : black_height l ≠ -1) (hhe : black_height r = black_height l)
    (hpl : satisfies_red_props l) (hpr : satisfies_red_props r)
    (hrb : is_red r = false)
    (hnd : is_red l = true → is_red (leftN l) = false) :
    view (Node.Tree c x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} ∧
    is_bst (Node.Tree c x l r) ∧
    black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) = black_height l + bhOff c ∧
    satisfies_red_props (Node.Tree c x l r) ∧
    (c = Color.Black → OK (Node.Tree c x l r)) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ⟨hlx, hbl, hxr, hbr⟩, bh_tree_eq c x l r hhl hhe,
    (props_tree c x l r).2 ⟨hpl, hpr, hrb, hnd⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro rfl h
  simp at h

theorem balL_spec (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hbl : is_bst l) (hbr : is_bst r)
    (hlx : ∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) (hxr : ∀ y ∈ view r, y > x)
    (hhl : black_height l ≠ -1) (hhe : black_height r = black_height l)
    (hpl : satisfies_red_props l) (hpr : satisfies_red_props r)
    (hrb : is_red r = false)
    (hcb : is_red l = true → is_red (leftN l) = true → c = Color.Black) :
    view (balL c x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} ∧
    is_bst (balL c x l r) ∧
    black_height (balL c x l r) = black_height l + bhOff c ∧
    satisfies_red_props (balL c x l r) ∧
    (c = Color.Black → OK (balL c x l r)) := by
  by_cases hd : is_red l = true ∧ is_red (leftN l) = true
  · -- double red on the left spine: rotate right and flip the colours
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := hd
    have hc : c = Color.Black := hcb hd1 hd2
    subst hc
    cases l with
    | Empty => simp at hd1
    | Tree cl xl ll lr =>
        cases cl with
        | Black => simp at hd1

            | Empty => simp at hd2

                | Black => simp at hd2

                      bh_inv Color.Red xl (Node.Tree Color.Red xll lll rll) lr hhl

                    have hlrh : black_height lr = black_height lll := by
                      rw [hB, hllh]
                    have hrh : black_height r = black_height lll := by
                      rw [hhe, bh_tree_eq Color.Red xl
                        (Node.Tree Color.Red xll lll rll) lr hA hB, hllh]
                      simp [bhOff]
                    have hL : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black xll lll rll)
                        = black_height lll + 1 := by
                      rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Black xll lll rll hC hD]; simp [bhOff]
                    have hR : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black x lr r)
                        = black_height lll + 1 := by
                      rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Black x lr r (by rw [hlrh]; exact hC)
                        (by rw [hrh, hlrh]), hlrh]
                      simp [bhOff]
                    have hlllge := bh_ge lll hC
                    -- colour facts
                    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩ :=
                      (props_tree Color.Red xl
                        (Node.Tree Color.Red xll lll rll) lr).1 hpl
                    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4⟩ :=
                      (props_tree Color.Red xll lll rll).1 hp1

                    have hb1' : ∀ y ∈ view (Node.Tree Color.Black xll lll rll),

                    have hbstL : is_bst (Node.Tree Color.Black xll lll rll) := hb2

                    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

                      simp only [view_tree', Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
                      tauto
                    · refine (bst_tree' _ _ _ _).2 ⟨hb1', hbstL, ?_, hbstR⟩
                      intro y hy

                      · rcases hy with hy | hy
                        · exact hb3 y hy
                        · exact lt_trans hxlx (hxr y hy)
                      · have hy' : y = x := hy
                        omega
                    · rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Red xl
                          (Node.Tree Color.Black xll lll rll)
                          (Node.Tree Color.Black x lr r)
                          (by rw [hL]; omega) (by rw [hL, hR]), hL,
                        bh_tree_eq Color.Red xl
                          (Node.Tree Color.Red xll lll rll) lr hA hB, hllh]
                      simp only [bhOff]
                      omega
                    · refine (props_tree Color.Red xl _ _).2 ⟨?_, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
                      · exact (props_tree Color.Black xll lll rll).2
                          ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4⟩
                      · exact (props_tree Color.Black x lr r).2
                          ⟨hp2, hpr, hrb, by
                            intro h; rw [hp3] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)⟩
                    · intro _ _; simp

    rw [balL_eq_node c x l r hd]
    exact node_spec c x l r hbl hbr hlx hxr hhl hhe hpl hpr hrb
      (fun h1 => by
        by_cases h2 : is_red (leftN l) = true
        · exact absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hd
        · simpa using h2)

theorem balR_spec (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hbl : is_bst l) (hbr : is_bst r)
    (hlx : ∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) (hxr : ∀ y ∈ view r, y > x)
    (hhl : black_height l ≠ -1) (hhe : black_height r = black_height l)
    (hpl : satisfies_red_props l) (hpr : satisfies_red_props r)
    (hlok : is_red l = true → is_red (leftN l) = false)
    (hrok : is_red r = true → is_red (leftN r) = false)
    (hcb : is_red l = true → c = Color.Black) :
    view (balR c x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} ∧
    is_bst (balR c x l r) ∧
    black_height (balR c x l r) = black_height l + bhOff c ∧
    satisfies_red_props (balR c x l r) ∧
    (c = Color.Black → OK (balR c x l r)) := by
  by_cases hrred : is_red r = true
  · cases r with
    | Empty => simp at hrred
    | Tree cr xr lr rr =>
        cases cr with
        | Black => simp at hrred
        | Red =>
            have hlrb : is_red lr = false := hrok rfl
            obtain ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩ :=
              (props_tree Color.Red xr lr rr).1 hpr
            obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4⟩ := hbr
            obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ :=
              bh_inv Color.Red xr lr rr (by rw [hhe]; exact hhl)
            have hrh : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red xr lr rr)
                = black_height lr := by
              rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Red xr lr rr hA hB]; simp [bhOff]
            have hlh : black_height l = black_height lr := by
              rw [← hhe]; exact hrh
            have hxxr : x < xr := hxr xr (Or.inr rfl)
            by_cases hlred : is_red l = true
            · -- both children red: flip the colours
              have hc : c = Color.Black := hcb hlred
              subst hc
              cases l with
              | Empty => simp at hlred
              | Tree cl xl ll rl =>
                  cases cl with
                  | Black => simp at hlred
                  | Red =>
                      rw [balR_flip x xl xr ll rl lr rr]
                      obtain ⟨hs1, hs2, hs3, hs4⟩ :=
                        (props_tree Color.Red xl ll rl).1 hpl
                      obtain ⟨hA2, hB2⟩ := bh_inv Color.Red xl ll rl hhl
                      have hllge := bh_ge ll hA2
                      have hlh2 : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red xl ll rl)
                          = black_height ll := by
                        rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Red xl ll rl hA2 hB2]; simp [bhOff]
                      have hL : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black xl ll rl)
                          = black_height ll + 1 := by
                        rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Black xl ll rl hA2 hB2]; simp [bhOff]
                      have hR : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black xr lr rr)
                          = black_height ll + 1 := by
                        rw [bh_tree_eq Color.Black xr lr rr hA hB, ← hlh, hlh2]
                        simp [bhOff]
                      have hbstL : is_bst (Node.Tree Color.Black xl ll rl) := hbl
                      have hbstR : is_bst (Node.Tree Color.Black xr lr rr) :=
                        ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4⟩

/-- Set shuffling used when the new value lands in the left subtree. -/
theorem union_shuffle_l (A B : Set Int) (v x : Int) :
    A ∪ {v} ∪ B ∪ {x} = (A ∪ B ∪ {x}) ∪ {v} := by
  ext y; simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto

/-- Set shuffling used when the new value lands in the right subtree. -/
theorem union_shuffle_r (A B : Set Int) (v x : Int) :
    A ∪ (B ∪ {v}) ∪ {x} = (A ∪ B ∪ {x}) ∪ {v} := by
  ext y; simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto

/-- Set shuffling used when the value is already present. -/
theorem union_dup (A B : Set Int) (v : Int) :
    A ∪ B ∪ {v} = (A ∪ B ∪ {v}) ∪ {v} := by
  ext y; simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto
